title: Implement Library Route Map phase 4
summary: Add guided policy navigation from route-map nodes into existing Library Profile controls.
reason: Operators need graph-node navigation to the current route/size controls without adding a second settings editor or new save path.
behavior_before: Route-related library settings were editable only by manually finding fields in the Library Profile editor.
behavior_after: Read-only route-map nodes can focus existing Library Profile controls, where existing Stage Patch, Preview, and Save buttons remain the only settings mutation path.
manual_validation: Libraries tab static tests prove panels are after profile controls and route-map asset uses read-only GET routes only
browser smoke route-map guided navigation reached existing Library Profile tabs before unrelated queue-scope failure
rollback_plan: Remove the guided navigation DOM hooks, WebView event handling, related tests, summaries, and this change packet.
notes: Navigation selects/highlights existing controls only. It does not save settings or add mutation buttons inside route-map evidence panels.
